headline: FTC Orders Delta, Uber, and Airlines to Provide Algorithmic Pricing Data
summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission ordered nine companies, including Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, JetBlue, Lyft, and Uber, to detail how they use algorithms and loyalty programs to set customer prices and driver wages.
why: The FTC enforces consumer protection and antitrust law in the United States, regulating corporate pricing practices and market competition across major transportation and retail sectors.
